en: This postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of an ornately carved historical bed, identified as the 'Historische Bettstelle des Grafen von Gleichen' (historical bedstead of the Count of Gleichen), standing in a richly decorated, classical room with detailed wall art and paneling. The reverse side indicates museum branding and address information, along with handwritten notations and publisher details.
